pr_semantic_analysis.change_summary: Form transition state detection was tightened so a form is treated as already stateful only when its hook chain includes a subsequent hook. The accompanying regression test targets two closely timed submissions and expects both form actions to run without an exception.

behavior_changes.description: When a form is submitted again shortly after an asynchronous submission begins, React is now intended to complete both submission attempts without throwing; the regression scenario observes two action invocations. Internally, a form with only one existing state hook is no longer considered fully upgraded to the state required for host transitions.
evidence: The stateful-form guard now requires both an existing hook and a following hook before reusing the existing form state.
The added test triggers requestSubmit twice around an asynchronous form action and asserts that the action ran twice.
